name: Coastal Plastic Molding Inc
old_description: Coastal Plastics Molding, Inc. is a full-service design engineering and manufacturer of injection molded and thermoplastic parts, extruded
about:
Coastal Plastics Molding, Inc. was founded in 1984 in Alvin, Texas, just south of Houston, as a family-owned operation. Over four decades it has grown from a small local shop into a manufacturing partner serving customers across the United States.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding, offering design engineering support, in-house tooling and mold making, prototyping, short-run and high-volume production. Its 20,000-square-foot facility runs 24/7 with a mix of electric and hydraulic presses, including a 180-ton JSW all-electric machine. Secondary operations include trimming, drilling, assembly, packaging and stocking programs. Materials processed range from ABS and polycarbonate to polypropylene and other thermoplastics.

Coastal Plastics serves a broad range of industries, including pharmaceuticals, medical devices, aerospace, construction, industrial equipment, electronics, consumer products, geophysical and filtration.

The company emphasizes that manufacturing is "more than machines," citing quality, integrity, innovation and local pride as core values. It keeps all operations in Texas to maintain strict quality control and fast turnaround without relying on overseas suppliers, and its quality control department operates independently to ensure part consistency.
